description: Verify the signature on an HTTP request, response or webhook and explain a failure. Handles RFC 9421 HTTP Message Signatures with RFC 9530 Content-Digest (the scheme UCP uses) for ecdsa-p256-sha256, ecdsa-p384-sha384, ed25519, hmac-sha256, rsa-pss-sha512 and rsa-v1_5-sha256, and the ACP order-webhook Merchant-Signature HMAC. Pass the message as text (start line, headers, blank line, body) and the key (a JWK, JWK Set, UCP profile, PEM public key or shared secret). Returns the verdict, the exact signature base that was checked, and specific causes such as a changed body, a missing covered component, a wrong key or a DER-encoded ECDSA signature. Never send a production private key; only a public key or a test secret is needed.

authority.description: The host the signer saw, if a proxy changed the Host header.

key.description: The verification key: a JWK, a JWK Set, a UCP profile with keys[], a PEM public key, or the shared secret for HMAC.

message.description: The HTTP message exactly as sent: request or status line, headers, a blank line, then the body.

now.description: Verification time in Unix seconds, for created/expires and ACP timestamp checks. Defaults to the current time.

scheme.description: Which scheme to check. "auto" decides from the headers present.

url_scheme.description: The URL scheme the signer saw, for @scheme and @target-uri.

name: http_signature_verify
title: Verify an HTTP message signature
